paragraphs: Eventeny sells event management software that makes it easier to manage vendors, volunteers, attendees, sponsors and maps in one place. The platform is used for festivals, conferences, expos, markets, parades and community gatherings.

Organizers build maps from scratch or on Google Maps with a drag-and-drop event mapping tool. Booths are assigned and spaces connected to tickets from that same place. Vendor and artist applications move through flexible workflows with built-in jury tools. Ticketing covers sales, upgrades and guest check-in with QR codes. Volunteer shifts can be scheduled, team leads assigned, and the crew contacted in one place. Sponsor packages can be customized to fit an event's needs.

Eventeny was started by two founders, Aly Hussaini and Nausheen Punjani. The company says its product marketplace hosts over 4,000 small business owners around the country. Its homepage says more than 2,550,000 users in five or more countries are on Eventeny. It reports over 34,000 events hosted on the platform. Case studies include the City of Suwanee, whose small event team was hosting more than 40 events a year with a primarily paper-based system.

quote.text: Outfox chaos with an easy all-in-one planning tool
